request: Find another 171Yb 578 nm experimental article with power, explicitly defined waist and independently measured Rabi frequency for independent cross-validation.
scopeBoundary: A bounded search and source review; not a claim that no such paper exists worldwide.
acceptanceCriteria: measured incident power at the atoms for the same measurement
unambiguous beam radius/diameter and intensity definition
independently measured Rabi frequency, from time-domain data or an identified spectroscopic fit; not inferred merely from FWHM or a nominal pi time
same operating point, known addressed polarization/channel and relevant motional conditions

candidates.title: Portable laser-cooled ytterbium beam clock based on an ultra-narrow optical transition
sourceLocations: Main text printed p.678, Eq.(2) and diameter statement

observed.powerModelStatement: Effective fitted P0 is approximately 1/3 of measured laser power.
observed.polarization: linear, addresses both mF=+/-1/2 ground states
observed.measurementMethod: Doppler contrast vs longitudinal velocity; effective coupling fit, not direct time-domain flopping
observed.interactionBeams: single input routed into four interaction beams by folded optics; no equal four-way splitting assumed

missingForMatchedBenchmark: 1mm diameter explicitly mapped to Gaussian 1/e^2 intensity diameter at the interaction region
numerical power at each interaction location / optical transmission and mode overlap
addressed q components and dipole/saturation-intensity convention
candidates.reason: 338mW is a fit parameter, not an independent measured input. A contrast-derived coupling can be eligible in principle, but 1070mW is stage-available power and the exact waist/channel/interaction-power mapping remains incomplete. Feeding 338mW back into the same scalar-coupling model is circular.
